outputs: cct2_ids := set of ids where kind contains 'complete' (likely {3,4})
K_ids := set of ids matching one of 8 IN-list literals ('superhero','sequel','second-part','marvel-comics','based-on-comic','tv-special','fight','violence')
CHN := vector<bool> sized (3140339+1), set true at matching chn.id

join_order.notes: Scan cc once; collect M_cc := { movie_id where subject_id==cct1_id AND status_id ∈ cct2_ids }. cct2_ids small (~2), store as scalar compare or 4-bit mask.
For each kid in K_ids: walk CSR slice mkk_off[kid]..mkk_off[kid+1]; gather mk.movie_id. Union into M_kw bitset over title row-space (size 2528313).
For each candidate mv: check title.kind_id[mv-1]==kt_movie AND title.production_year[mv-1] > 1950 AND != INT32_MIN.
For each surviving mv: lo=ci_mid_off[mv-1], hi=ci_mid_off[mv]; for r in [lo,hi): if person_role_id[r] != INT32_MIN AND CHN[person_role_id[r]] -> hit. n is dense and unfiltered, so no n probe needed.

filters.predicate: name NOT LIKE '%Sherlock%' AND (LIKE '%Tony%Stark%' OR LIKE '%Iron%Man%')
production_year > 1950 AND != INT32_MIN AND kind_id == kt_movie

data_structures.cct2_ids: small flat_array<int32_t> (<=2 entries) or 4-bit mask over comp_cast_type id space
data_structures.M_cc: vector<bool> sized title_max_id+1 (~2.5M bits ≈ 0.3 MB) OR sorted vector<int32_t> of distinct movie_ids from cc scan
data_structures.M_kw: vector<bool> sized title_max_id+1 (~2.5M bits ≈ 0.3 MB), accumulate by ORing across 8 keyword slices
data_structures.candidate_movies: iteration loop intersects M_cc and M_kw on the fly

details: char_name LIKE scan: parallel chunked over name.off ranges, each thread sets bits in CHN (independent bit positions; use atomic-free per-thread bitsets then OR-reduce, or chunked disjoint id ranges so bits are non-overlapping).
movie_keyword keyword_id CSR slices: parallel over 8 K_ids, each writes M_kw bits in disjoint movie space — use per-thread bitsets + OR-reduce.
Candidate movie probe loop (filter + cast_info range scan): morsel-driven over candidate mv list; each thread maintains a local (min_title_view, min_mv); final reduction picks the min.

indexes.purpose: not used; direct scan of 135K rows is cheaper
join_lookup: movie -> cast_info row range for chn probe
